entities.summary: Siranush Andriasian (b. 1986-01-04, Vagharshapat) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Vagharshapat and Armenia. Known in the fields of armenia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
